section_title: Financial crime risks in relation to other types of risks > Case example: A lasting lesson

coverage_audit.proposition: Inadequate transaction monitoring and fragmented, ineffective compliance framework allow money laundering, as demonstrated by HSBC allowing drug cartels to launder US$880 million.
coverage_audit.reason: 普通案例机制，基础KG已能表达由控制不完善导致洗钱的事实。

coverage_audit.proposition: An AML compliance breach triggers a record regulatory fine, as US regulators imposed US$1.9 billion penalty on HSBC.
coverage_audit.reason: 合规违规引发罚款的一般因果，基础KG可存储罚款事实。

coverage_audit.proposition: Entering into a deferred prosecution agreement requires the financial institution to implement a comprehensive overhaul of its global compliance operations.
coverage_audit.reason: DPA要求全面整改属于外部命令触发特定机构应对的有向结构，超过基础KG的简单案例陈述。

coverage_audit.proposition: A regulatory investigation into AML failures can force the resignation of senior executives, including the Global Head of Compliance.
coverage_audit.reason: 调查导致高管辞职属于案例中的事件结果，基础KG可存储。

coverage_audit.proposition: When a bank's internal environment prioritizes local business interests and profit over robust centralized compliance controls, it contributes to AML compliance failures.
coverage_audit.reason: 内部环境优先利润导致合规失败属于原因解释，基础KG可存储。

coverage_audit.proposition: A money laundering scandal triggers immediate regulatory and financial backlash and inflicts lasting reputational damage, eroding customer trust and weakening market position.
coverage_audit.reason: 丑闻触发监管和声誉损害属于一般事件-后果链，基础KG可存储。

coverage_audit.proposition: Strengthening central oversight and compliance functions while limiting the autonomy of local business units helps restore the integrity of the financial crime risk management framework and reduces exposure to high-risk jurisdictions through strategic de-risking.
coverage_audit.reason: 具体整改措施及目标构成局部程序链，超过基础KG的简单纠正描述。

coverage_audit.proposition: Weak financial crime controls lead to severe financial penalties, operational disruption, and irrevocable damage to a bank's reputation, ultimately undermining its long-term viability in the global market.
coverage_audit.reason: 总结教训的一般因果关系，基础KG可存储。

cards.title: DPA要求触发的银行合规重组措施

flow_nodes.label: 美国司法部与汇丰达成五年延期起诉协议，要求全面整改全球合规运营 (Five-year deferred prosecution agreement mandating comprehensive overhaul of global compliance operations)
汇丰银行被迫重新平衡组织权力，加强中央监督和合规职能，并限制地方业务部门自主权 (HSBC was compelled to rebalance power dynamics, strengthening central oversight and compliance functions while limiting the autonomy of local business units)

flow_edges.source_quote: mandating a comprehensive overhaul of its global compliance operations; the bank was compelled to rebalance power dynamics within its organization

cards.review_notes: 增量命题：DPA要求全面整改（entry）→ 银行被迫执行加强中央监督和限制地方自治等具体措施（process）。KG不足：基础KG只能存储“汇丰达成DPA并采取了纠正措施”的事实，无法表达DPA作为外部命令约束金融机构实施特定结构改革的程序性有向关系。选项判断：可确认纠正措施的具体内容及其触发来源。LLM推理：无。
